intended_object: This is the open inclusion U_σ → X_Φ of the affine toric chart for the negative ray σ = ℝ_{≤0} into the analytic toric variety of a regular fan Φ in ℝ¹, such as the fan of ℙ¹. It is packaged as a partial biholomorphism, i.e. a C^n partial diffeomorphism over ℂ, onto its open image. U_σ carries the complex structure given by the negative standard character. The description comes from the docstring and the module documentation (the affine charts of the toric projective line).
explanation:
The body is the library's general chart inclusion `Fan.analyticAffineChartPartialDiffeomorph`, applied to the cone ⟨negativeRayCone, hσ⟩. It is given the basis (-e₁) of ℤ¹, whose first vector `negativeRayBasis_extends` proves is a primitive generator of the ray, and the only possible numbering of the single ray. The lemmas just below the definition confirm the intended behaviour. The source is all of U_σ, the target is the range of `analyticAffineChartι` (the cone open), and the map itself is the canonical chart inclusion.

This is a concrete instance: one specific chart of rank-one toric varieties, used in the worked ℙ¹ example. Its content needs the special setting, namely the negative ray in ℝ¹ and its negative-character coordinate. The general construction already exists in the library as `analyticAffineChartPartialDiffeomorph`, and this definition only specializes it. So it is not too narrow.

Mathlib has no toric-variety counterpart. The definition matches its docstring.
